# REDTEAM #159 (SPEC Sec 8.4, T-301.2; IMPLEMENTATION.md M19-S5, M19-S7):
# Moving collector breaking pointer-keyed map lookup. Pinned blocks MUST
# NOT evacuate. Pointer-keyed maps under zgc MUST use a side-table identity
# hash that survives relocation (32-bit, off-heap, never an object header).
# The compiler emits the identity hasher for pointer-word map keys, so a
# key inserted by its source address must still be found by the copy's
# address after relocation, for pointer keys and for structs, arrays, and
# interior pointers containing them, including reflect.MapOf keys hashed
# by runtime.typehash. Address-hashed immix blocks set the pin bit and
# never evacuate.
#
# This script runs three direct unit gates: TestLogosZgcCompiledBarrier
# (inner run under -lb, so the hashers under test are the ones the compiler
# emits), TestLogosImmixPin (pin bit set on the addressed block only), and
# TestLogosMoveScenarios (every scenario under immix with and without the
# verification pass, plus the same program under the plain collector where
# nothing may move, including the pinner and mapkey scenarios). Value-only checks would pass on a
# stale address hash; these gates fail on lookup miss, key duplication on
# assign-by-copy, and any move of a pinned object.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosgcmoving
go test -count=1 -run 'TestLogosZgcCompiledBarrier$' runtime
go test -count=1 -run 'TestLogosImmixPin$' runtime
go test -count=1 -run 'TestLogosMoveScenarios' runtime
go test -race -count=1 -run 'TestLogosZgcCompiledBarrier$' runtime
go test -race -count=1 -run 'TestLogosImmixPin$' runtime
go test -race -count=1 -run 'TestLogosMoveScenarios' runtime

-- go.mod --
module example.com/redteam159

go 1.27
